variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, short height, long slender, mega variety suitable for cultivation under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 1994 for planting in Boro season. Most widely grown variety in all over Bangladesh. Excellent performance in irrigation scarcity belt. High grain elongation and volume expansion ratio. Tolerant to leaf blight and sheath blight. Susceptible to leaf blast
